# Capability reference — SoundCraft / SML Studio 0.5.0

<!-- GENERATED by `cargo xtask docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

What this build states about itself. Hand-reviewed capability status (what was observed on which machine) is in [USER_GUIDE.md](../USER_GUIDE.md#2-capability-status); this page is generated from code and cannot say what works on your hardware.

## Stated limits (`help.limits`)

| Applies to | Limit |
|---|---|
| `clip.warp_*` | Bend: segments between anchors are joined with a 10 ms crossfade at each anchor (where the two sides differ in phase the level can dip briefly), ratio 0.25..4 per segment, stereo shares one map; listening review is a native gate |
| `clip.remove_warp` | restores the original material recorded on the first warp |
| `audition*` | Listen: only while the transport is stopped and not recording; never saved; explicit mutes still win |
| `automation.draw` | automation lanes only; the clip-gain envelope has its own command (clip.gain_draw) |
| `clip.gain_draw` | clip-gain envelope in dB (−144..+36) of one clip |
| `nudge*` | keypad vs top-row keys are not distinguished by the UI toolkit (B03); physical keypad use is a native gate |
| `options.quickpunch` | DISABLED: not implemented (B04) |
| `options.trackpunch` | DISABLED: not implemented (B04) |
| `options.destructive*` | DISABLED: not implemented (B04) |
| `loop*` | Loop Playback loops the stored loop range when one is set, else the edit selection; Loop Record records over the edit selection (loop.select copies the loop range into it); locators cannot move while recording |
| `transport.record` | takes are placed from backend capture timestamps; loop record and punch use the documented scheduler |
| `file.bounce*` | no compressed export formats; monitor controls never reach a bounce |
| `mix.monitor_mode` | hardware monitoring means the interface mixes the input; the app cannot verify the interface's own mix |
| `plugin*` | hosted plugins run in-process by default (no crash containment); the opt-in `sandbox:<id>` mode runs a plugin out of process with one block of added latency and no native editor (E03); scanning is isolated |
| `assistant*` | grounded rules by default; an optional LOCAL language model server (none ships; loopback only) may propose actions that are validated before preview; speech is a built-in enrolled-phrase recognizer (quiet rooms; not dictation) and a robotic formant voice on the monitor output only; plans run only as validated commands at the current revision |
| `mastering*` | meters follow BS.1770-4 / R128 / Tech 3342 and are checked against analytic test signals (E07), not certified; the reference is monitor-only |
| `session*` | autosave keeps rolling validated generations; power-loss guarantees are unverified (E02) |

## External control interfaces

Control-channel methods (JSON lines over TCP to the running desktop app; [control-protocol.md](../control-protocol.md)): `app.quit`, `document.inspect`, `engine.commands`, `engine.execute`, `engine.parity`, `session.inspect`, `ui.click`, `ui.drag`, `ui.inspect`, `ui.key`, `ui.menu.invoke`, `ui.menu.list`, `ui.move`, `ui.screenshot`, `ui.set`, `ui.text`.

MCP tools (`soundcraft-cli mcp`, optionally `--connect PORT` to the running app; [mcp.md](../mcp.md)): `list_commands`, `execute`, `batch`, `inspect_session`, `new_session`, `open_session`, `save_session`, `import_audio`, `bounce_mix`, `parity`, `screenshot`, `ui_inspect`, `ui_set`, `menu_invoke`, `click`, `drag`, `key`.

Counts: 538 engine commands (259 undoable, 16 destructive by the registry's rule, 4 disabled), 93 UI-layer commands.
